evidence.name: Screen field: How tall the media is
evidence.userNeed: Know what "How tall the media is" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: How tall the media is
sections.description: Sets the media height as a share of the screen (0 to 100%), so it scales on every device; the default is 50%. Use a larger percentage for an immersive, image-led screen and a smaller one when you need room for the title, text, or button below; on a choice screen, keep it modest so the options stay visible without scrolling. Setting a value pins the media just below the header for a consistent layout.
